title: plugin-email: GET /api/settings/mail serves no live.provider, so the hosted platform mail channel cannot read as configured (#32643 item 1, cloud#4386)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsRT6hvZsQH9dTzn4CA

Filing gate: ② the remaining half of a ruled card, split out after measurement. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.

Source: #32643 (coordinator 6819876581 item 1, after cloud#4386 「A 平台默认代发」), PR #32797, out-of-scope finding 2 in the os-dev-report on #32643.

## The rule this follows

The coordinator, item 1: "When the platform channel is present (hosted, once cloud#4386 ships), mail counts as configured. The checklist's mail row reads done with no administrator action… Either the hosted mail namespace reports the platform channel as a configured provider, or `isMailConfigured` accepts it. The cloud lane and this lane agree which, and it is recorded here."

## Measured on `main`

- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts` `registerLiveStatus('mail')` and `live-transport-status.ts` `describeLiveMailTransport` return `label`, `bannerSeverity` and `bannerText` only, with no `values`.
- So `GET /api/settings/mail` serves no `live.provider` with a `source`. The console's checklist cannot read a hosted platform channel as configured the way `aiProviderState` reads the `ai` namespace (`live.provider { value, source }`).
- PR #32797 makes the mail row optional, ruling item 2. The row now never holds the checklist open, but on hosted it reads "not done" even when the platform channel delivers.

## Do

Have `plugin-email`'s live status state the provider in use, in the same shape the `ai` namespace's `live.provider` takes (`{ value, source: 'settings' | 'environment' | 'platform' | 'none' }`, or whatever the cloud lane agrees for the platform channel). Then a follow-up ui change reads it in `isMailConfigured`, as `aiProviderState` does. Agree the shape with the cloud lane (cloud#4386) and record it on #32643's thread.

Dedupe words: mail live provider, live.provider mail, platform mail channel, describeLiveMailTransport values.
